title: DataQuality
description: Quality metadata attached to a provider or provenance-bearing response (architecture.md §8.2).

freshness.description: 'unavailable' (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.0 correction pass) is a purely additive new enum value: no data or estimate exists at all, distinct from 'estimated' (a computed fallback, e.g. Haversine distance, genuinely exists). 'mixed' (Manual QA remediation Q.1, user correction pass §C) is a second additive value -- mirrors ProviderResponseEnvelope.schema.json's own 'data_mode' enum exactly, since 'freshness' always echoes that same value. Every pre-existing document using only the original values remains valid unchanged.
